questions.stem: A reporter is preparing a piece on the vehicle industry. Explain what the vehicles it makes are used for, and state what the coming in of new and contemporary models after liberalisation did to demand and to growth.

markingPoints.description: States that the vehicles are used for industrial application, agriculture or directly for consumer markets
States that after liberalisation the coming in of new and contemporary models stimulated the demand for vehicles in the market
States that this led to the healthy growth of the industry

answerScheme.modelAnswer: The vehicles are used for industrial application, agriculture or directly for consumer markets. After liberalisation, the coming in of new and contemporary models stimulated the demand for vehicles in the market, which led to the healthy growth of the industry.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: A cement company is deciding where to set up its manufacturing units. In steps, (a) name the heavy raw materials the units will need, (b) state what else the units require apart from the raw materials, and (c) explain why Gujarat has been chosen for locating such plants.

markingPoints.description: Names limestone, silica and gypsum as the heavy raw materials the units require
States that coal and electric power are needed
States that rail transportation is needed apart from the raw materials and the power
States that the industry has strategically located plants in Gujarat
Explains that Gujarat was chosen because the plants there have suitable access to the market in the Gulf countries

answerScheme.modelAnswer:
Step 1: The units require heavy raw materials: limestone, silica and gypsum.
Step 2: Coal and electric power are needed.
Step 3: Rail transportation is needed apart from the raw materials and the power.
Step 4: The industry has strategically located plants in Gujarat.
Step 5: Gujarat has been chosen because the plants sited there have suitable access to the market in the Gulf countries, so they can reach that market.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem:
A software exporter has signed a contract to supply computer equipment to buyers in several cities. The exporter's office studies where similar suppliers are already located before agreeing on a delivery schedule. One adviser points out that one city has already earned the title of electronic capital, while eight other places are named as important centres for electronic goods. She adds that the trade runs from transistor sets and televisions to telephones, telephone exchanges, radars and computers. Another adviser warns that a newcomer should not expect these centres to handle every order, and that some business lies elsewhere.

(a) Name the city that has earned the title of electronic capital. (b) The exporter must also reach buyers outside that city; name four of the eight other important centres for electronic goods, and give a reason from what the adviser says why ignoring them would be a mistake.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: (a) Bengaluru, which has emerged as the electronic capital of India. (b) Any four of Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Lucknow and Coimbatore. Ignoring them is a mistake because these centres do not handle every order and some business lies elsewhere.
